_comment: Compiled from current source docs only (never from deprecated v2). Each rule cites the doc_id/section it was compiled from, so calculator output can show its provenance. Do not hand-edit without updating the source doc first.

BOOKED.note: Fee fully waived pre-pickup, no time limit. PICKED_UP rule is NOT overridden — still falls back to default (not cancellable, use return-to-origin).

service_credit.note: Per-incident formula/threshold NOT overridden — default SOP formula still applies, only the monthly cap changes.

cancellation.note: Explicitly NOT overridden. Use default_cancellation as-is.

service_credit.note: Flat INR 300 credit, threshold raised to >4 hours. Replaces default amount and threshold.

sla.coverage_note: No weekend or after-hours support coverage.
